info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Mortgage Loans Preapprovals-v3-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Preapproval Listing API provides users with the capability to access a comprehensive list of mortgage loan preapproval requests. This endpoint facilitates the retrieval of existing preapproval records, allowing financial institutions and real estate professionals to assess potential borrowers. Typical consumers include mortgage lenders, real estate agents, and financial analysts seeking to streamline the preapproval process. The API supports efficient data access to enhance decision-making and customer service in the mortgage sector.

get.description: Retrieves the preapproval information for a loan application, allowing users and developers to evaluate loan eligibility based on specified parameters.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a preapproval for a loan. The provided data must contain the necessary information regarding the borrower's financial details to assess eligibility.

200.description: The preapproval request completed successfully, returning preapproval details.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsRequest.description: The request body for preapproval operations on loans.

status.description: Indicates if the preapproval operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the preapproval request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the preapproval operation.

state.description: The current state of the preapproval request.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the preapproval request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message accompanying the response, providing additional context.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsResponse_20.description: Schema representing the successful response for a GET preapproval operation.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the preapproval request.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the preapproval request was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the preapproval operation was done automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing the audit details of the preapproval request.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request in milliseconds. A value of 0 signifies that the processing was instantaneous.
